quote: Power is everywhere; not because it embraces everything, but because it comes from everywhere.
author: Michel Foucault
source: The History of Sexuality, Volume 1: An Introduction

quote: This world is the will to power—and nothing besides! And you yourselves are also this will to power—and nothing besides!
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quote: Power corresponds to the human ability not just to act but to act in concert.
author: Hannah Arendt

quote: Justice is the first virtue of social institutions, as truth is of systems of thought.
author: John Rawls

quote: Injustice anywhere is a threat to justice everywhere.
author: Martin Luther King Jr.

quote: Justice is the having and doing of what is one's own, and belongs to oneself.
author: Plato

quote: Truth is the daughter of time, not of authority.
author: Francis Bacon

quote: The truth is rarely pure and never simple.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: Truth is the first chapter in the book of wisdom.
author: Thomas Jefferson
